description: Genie Ontology Modeled Knowledge SDK pipeline run for project {{project_name}}, domain {{domain_name}}: inputs check, parallel discovery (research, supplemental context, deep EDA), metric view synthesis, registration, UC Pages + Genie Agent curation, agent deployment, tuning. Rendered by genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.scaffold from templates/run/.

waves.name: Inputs Check
gate: All session status files have status pass
sdk_config.json passes genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.config.validate_config with 0 errors (PYTHONPATH=ontology-metric-views/src or an installed genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk)
docs/inputs_report.md exists, lists every expanded source table, and its '## Access problems' section says 'none'

sessions.title: Inputs Check & Report
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 01: load and validate sdk_config.json, expand source tables, run config.check_access, write docs/inputs_report.md. Read-only on Unity Catalog. No Git commands.

waves.name: Discovery (research, context, EDA in parallel)
gate: All session status files have status pass
docs/research/ has 01-04 research docs plus 05_domain_subdomain_proposal.md, each with at least one URL
docs/semantics/ has at least one glossary term file and genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.pages.parse_glossary('docs/semantics') parses all of them without error
docs/context/00_source_inventory.md exists (it may state 'no supplemental inputs provided')
docs/data_profiles/ has one profile per table listed in docs/inputs_report.md plus data_model_summary.md, whose join table has a verified_cardinality for every row

sessions.title: Domain Research & Glossary
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 02 using skills/ontology-domain-research: docs/research/01-05 and glossary term files in docs/semantics/ for {{domain_name}}. Metadata-only table reads. No Git commands.

sessions.title: Supplemental Context Extraction
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 03 using skills/ontology-context-extraction: read supplemental_volume_dirs and dashboard_inputs (read-only) and write docs/context/**, including the no-inputs path. No Git commands.

sessions.title: Deep EDA & Join Cardinality
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 04 using skills/ontology-deep-eda: one profile per source table and data_model_summary.md with verified join cardinalities. Read-only SQL. No Git commands.

waves.name: Metric View Synthesis
gate: All session status files have status pass

PYTHONPATH=ontology-metric-views/src python -m genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk_vendored.mv_yaml validate ontology-metric-views/metric_views exits 0 (or the same command with an installed genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk)
ontology-metric-views/metric_views/manifest.json exists, is a JSON array sorted by name, and lists every *.yml under metric_views/
No YAML under ontology-metric-views/metric_views/ contains a literal catalog in source: or joins[].source (rule MV004)
ontology-genie-agents passes bundle validate --strict after the render step its README documents, if any

sessions.title: Metric View YAML Synthesis
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 05 using skills/ontology-mv-synthesis: parameterized metric view YAML per business process and grain, materialization blocks where the EDA signals call for them, and manifest.json. Read-only SQL. No registration, no Git commands.

waves.name: Metric View Registration
gate: All session status files have status pass
docs/registration/registration_results.md exists and records a register_metric_views job run that finished SUCCESS after this build run started; report as check 'registration_job'
docs/registration/registration_results.md shows every manifest.json entry registered and the smoke_test and cardinality_test tasks SUCCESS; report as check 'mv_smoke'
ontology-genie-agents passes bundle validate --strict after the render step its README documents, if any

sessions.title: Metric View Registration & Smoke Tests
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 06: deploy the ontology-metric-views bundle to {{bundle_target}}, run its register_metric_views job, and record results in docs/registration/. Deploy only that bundle and target. No Git commands.

authorizations.target: register_metric_views job of the ontology-metric-views bundle ({{bundle_target}} target)
authorizations.reason: Registration is this session's deliverable; the job is run with bundle run register_metric_views.

waves.name: UC Pages + Genie Agent Curation
gate: All session status files have status pass
docs/pages/pages_results.md exists and lists one page per glossary term parsed from docs/semantics/ and docs/context/glossary_candidates/
ontology-genie-agents/agents/ has at least one *.geniespace.json and each passes genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.geniespace.validate_space
No agent references more than max_metric_views_per_agent metric views, and every referenced view is registered per docs/registration/registration_results.md
Committed agent files are tokenized: no literal catalog, schema or warehouse id
docs/domain_manifest.yml exists
ontology-genie-agents passes bundle validate --strict after the render step its README documents, if any

sessions.title: UC Pages Registration
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 07: parse glossary terms, upsert UC Pages with genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.pages (dry run first), associate them with the domain/subdomain when one exists, and write docs/pages/. No Git commands.

authorizations.target: UC Pages for the {{domain_name}} glossary terms
authorizations.reason: Creating and updating UC Pages through the Pages API is this session's deliverable.

sessions.title: Genie Agent Curation
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 08 using skills/ontology-agent-curation: plan agents with the max_metric_views_per_agent rule, write tokenized .geniespace.json files, one genie_spaces resource entry per agent, and docs/domain_manifest.yml. No deploy, no Git commands.

waves.name: Genie Agent Deployment
gate: All session status files have status pass
docs/deployment/deployment_results.md lists every agent with its deployed Genie space id, deployed after this build run started
docs/deployment/deployment_results.md shows every agent answered its first sample question with a SUCCEEDED query attachment; report as check 'agent_probe'

sessions.title: Genie Agent Deployment & Probe
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 09: render and deploy the ontology-genie-agents bundle to {{bundle_target}}, probe each agent with one sample question, and record space ids and results in docs/deployment/. Deploy only that bundle and target. No Git commands.

waves.name: Benchmark & Tuning
gate: All session status files have status pass
docs/tuning/tuning_plan.md and docs/tuning/benchmark_questions.yml exist, with 10-20 questions per agent
docs/tuning/benchmark_results.md exists, has a final run after this build run started, and every agent scores at least 70% accuracy; report as check 'benchmark_results'
PYTHONPATH=ontology-metric-views/src python -m genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk_vendored.mv_yaml validate ontology-metric-views/metric_views exits 0
ontology-genie-agents passes bundle validate --strict after the render step its README documents, if any

sessions.title: Benchmark & Tuning
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 10 using skills/ontology-tuning: generate benchmark questions, run the baseline, fix metric views first and agents last in at most 2 iterations, re-register and redeploy the project bundles on {{bundle_target}} as needed, and write docs/tuning/. No Git commands.

authorizations.target: register_metric_views job of the ontology-metric-views bundle ({{bundle_target}} target)
authorizations.reason: Re-registering tuned metric views before the re-run benchmark.
